title: refactor(ci): consolidate lint/test/release workflows and improve cache hygiene
author: Sofia Ramirez
commits: ci: split lint/test into reusable composite workflows
chore(ci): add centralized cache key strategy and explicit restore points
chore(ci): fix windows runner path in build-matrix
docs(ci): document new workflow composition and troubleshooting
chore(ci): add artifact cleanup job to release workflow
review_comments: Alex Chen: Nice consolidation; can we ensure matrix size doesn't regress developer inner loop? Suggest limiting matrix for PRs to node: [18] + core matrices on release jobs.
Sofia Ramirez (author): Good point — implemented conditional matrix expansion (only on workflow_dispatch and release tags). See commit ci: split lint/test into reusable composite workflows.
Maya Patel: Cache key looks better, but we hit a cache miss on linux-x86 in a previous run. Can we add OS+hash fallback to avoid cold starts?
Sofia Ramirez (author): Added fallback to include sha of package-lock and a deterministic tooling hash; fallback applied in cache-cleanup.sh and restore steps.
Jordan Lee: Approve after nit: move artifact cleanup to separate schedule to avoid long PR run time.
Sofia Ramirez (author): Moved cleanup to .github/workflows/cleanup-artifacts.yml scheduled at 03:00 UTC.
description: Motivation: repository CI workflows have grown organically and duplicated similar logic across lint/test/release pipelines. This causes maintenance overhead, inconsistent caching, and long PR runs. This PR consolidates reusable CI workflow components, standardizes cache keys and restore/fallback behavior, reduces matrix expansion for PRs, and extracts long-running cleanup into a scheduled job. Summary of changes: created composite workflows for lint/test/build to be reused by repo and subpackage workflows | standardized cache keys to use: cache-v1::${{ runner.os }}::node-<node-version>::deps-<sha-of-lockfiles>::tooling-<tooling-hash> with deterministic fallback to avoid cold-cache regressions | added conditional matrix expansion so full matrices run only on release workflows and workflow_dispatch | moved artifact cleanup to a scheduled workflow to keep PR runs fast | added short README under tools/ci to describe composition and troubleshooting Checklist: - [x] Extract reusable steps into .github/workflows/{lint.yml,test.yml,build-matrix.yml} as composite calls - [x] Replace duplicated steps in redwood/* workflows to call composites - [x] Implement deterministic cache key + fallback and explicit restore points - [x] Add schedule-based cleanup workflow and script (scripts/ci/cache-cleanup.sh) - [x] Document behavior and rollback instructions in tools/ci/README.md - [x] Run full CI matrix on a release-dryrun and confirm builds pass (see CI checks) Commits: ci: split lint/test into reusable composite workflows; chore(ci): add centralized cache key strategy and explicit restore points; chore(ci): fix windows runner path in build-matrix; docs(ci): document new workflow composition and troubleshooting; chore(ci): add artifact cleanup job to release workflow Files changed (high level): .github/workflows/* (consolidate and new composites), scripts/ci/cache-cleanup.sh (cleanup + cache fallback helpers), tools/ci/README.md (docs), minor updates in package.json for ci scripts, small adjustments in redwood/* workflow refs to use composites, infra/terraform/ci.tf (to avoid overlap with scheduler) Notable snippets: - composite usage example: uses: ./.github/workflows/lint.yml@main with inputs: node-version: '18' - cache key example: restore-keys: cache-v1::${{ runner.os }}::node-18::deps- (with tooling hash fallback) CI and verification: ran full release-dryrun on 2026-02-18, all checks passed after two re-runs addressing path and cache fallback fixes. Local smoke tests performed by author and reviewer for linux/mac/node18. Rollout and ops notes: we will monitor the main branch for two days after merge for any cache-related flakiness; rollback plan: revert the composite calls (small, single commit) if flakiness affects CI throughput. Linear/Jira: addresses ENG-4123 and ENG-4199; regression ticket SUP-887 was used to triage an earlier cache miss incident. Release notes: "ci: consolidate workflows and improve cache hygiene - no user-facing changes; infra maintenance" Impact: low risk to runtime code, medium impact to CI runtime and maintainability. Merged using squash strategy after approvals.
release_notes: ci: consolidate workflows and improve cache hygiene - maintenance only; no user-facing changes
notes: Monitored main after merge for two days; flagged one transient cache miss on 2026-02-21 that resolved after cache rewarm; no rollback needed.
